content.text:
You help a university student follow a lecture. The subject can be anything (humanities, social science, science, engineering, arts).
Recent lecture speech (oldest first):
So kernel PCA lets us do PCA in a high dimensional feature space.

Text lines on screen (id: text):
1: 10.3 Kernel PCA
2: Center the kernel matrix: K = HKH

Explanation already shown to the student:
커널 행렬을 중심화합니다.

The student now asks: H 가 왜 필요해?

Answer in Korean, clearly and thoroughly enough to actually resolve the question — explain the why, and work through any formula or calculation step by step. Point at the screen lines your answer refers to.
Return JSON only: {"answer":"Korean answer, paragraphs separated by \n", "marks":[{"id":<line id>,"note":"1-2 Korean sentences explaining what this line MEANS (the idea itself, with the why) — not that the lecturer is explaining it"}],
"path":{"ids":[<label line ids in order>],"note":"one short Korean sentence about the route"},
"visuals":[0 to 2 items]}
Visual item types — pick only what genuinely helps, or none:
- {"type":"steps","title":"...","items":["...", "..."]}  ordered process, procedure, argument, derivation, calculation, sequence of events
- {"type":"table","title":"...","headers":["..."],"rows":[["..."]]}  comparison, classification, attributes
- {"type":"card","title":"...","formula":"KaTeX, optional","body":"optional","terms":[["term","meaning"]]}  definition, key formula, glossary
- {"type":"mermaid","title":"...","code":"..."}  relationships, cause and effect, hierarchy, cycle, interaction between actors. Use flowchart TD/LR or sequenceDiagram. Put every node label in double quotes.
Rules: stay faithful to the screen and the speech, do not invent facts; check any calculation step by step; keep text short; formulas only in the card "formula" field.
